crossRefs.note: Unless Yahweh builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless Yahweh watches over the city, the watchman…
But I said, “I have labored in vain. I have spent my strength in vain for nothing; yet surely the justice due to me is…
Behold, isn’t it of Yahweh of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?
I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.
then I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field…
and Yahweh’s anger be kindled against you, and he shut up the sky so that there is no rain, and the land doesn’t yield…
The fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock will be…
You will carry much seed out into the field, and will gather little in, for the locust will consume it.
Locusts will consume all of your trees and the fruit of your ground.
let briers grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.
and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.
“You looked for much, and, behold, it came to little; and when you brought it home, I blew it away. Why?” says Yahweh…
Through all that time, when one came to a heap of twenty measures, there were only ten. When one came to the wine vat…
I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.

translations.web: Your strength will be spent in vain; for your land won’t yield its increase, neither will the trees of the land yield their fruit.
translations.bsb: and your strength will be spent in vain. For your land will not yield its produce, and the trees of the land will not bear their fruit.
translations.kjv: And your strength shall be spent in vain: for your land shall not yield her increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruits.
translations.asv: and your strength shall be spent in vain; for your land shall not yield its increase, neither shall the trees of the land yield their fruit.
